affected_boundaries: host observation to logical assignment release

observed_behavior: An integrated closed assignment with an idle waiting session remains occupied and a ready plan reserves a new worker instead of reusing its retained pair.
expected_behavior: A safe inactive pair is released logically and reused before creating a worker, without physically retiring its session or checkout.
causal_mechanism: Cleanup release independently recognizes only completed host sessions while reconciliation's canonical idle classification includes waiting and completed.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A downstream lifecycle transition duplicates an upstream state classification with a narrower predicate.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: An equivalent idle state is excluded, leaving a completed assignment occupying a reusable resource.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Logical release uses the canonical idle classification while preserving assignment completion and resource safety gates.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Cleanup release selects the assignment from reconciled idleSessions rather than independently testing one host state.

applicability_conditions: No pending action for the pair
confirmation_evidence: Real-Git differential test changed only host state: completed passed, waiting returned CREATE_WORKER instead of logical release.
Both cases passed after selecting canonical idleSessions; the entire 42-test scheduler file passed.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: integrated completed workers become reusable when another plan is ready
tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: integrated waiting workers become reusable when another plan is ready
